description.value: Heritage Asian Eatery is a casual downtown Vancouver spot in the Financial District serving classic Chinese comfort food with local ingredients in a communal, laid-back setting. The Pender Street location seats up to 60 guests and also accommodates private event bookings. It offers dine-in, takeout, and a relaxed vibe suited to a quick refuel stop.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 53m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active restaurant at what it states is 1108 West Pender Street, serving Chinese-inspired food with takeout available ('picking up takeout' is explicitly mentioned). However, there is a street number discrepancy: OSM records 1088 while the website states 1108. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records 1088 West Pender Street but the business website states 1108 West Pender Street. Used website value as primary source; OSM should be corrected.
No cycling-relevant amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) mentioned on website or in OSM tags — all required criteria remain unverified.

The address discrepancy between OSM (1088) and the website (1108) also needs resolution before listing.
